title: Social and Relationship Well-Being
description: A Cozy well-being check-in. Reflect on the quality of your social interactions and relationships.
disclaimer: This Cozy well-being check-in is for personal reflection. It is not a diagnosis or a validated clinical screening tool. The result describes only your answers to these five questions. If you are concerned about your well-being, speak with a qualified professional. If you feel unsafe or need urgent help, contact local emergency services or use the app's crisis support resources.

scoring_rules.recommendation: These descriptive result bands are for personal reflection and do not measure clinical severity.

bands.label: More support may help
bands.recommendation: Your answers suggest fewer experiences that support social well-being. Consider small ways to connect with trusted people or groups and communicate your support needs. If you are concerned, consider speaking with a qualified professional.

bands.label: Building well-being
bands.recommendation: Your answers suggest some experiences that support social well-being, with room to build on them. Consider small ways to connect with trusted people or groups and communicate your support needs.

bands.label: Good well-being
bands.recommendation: Your answers suggest regular experiences that support social well-being. Keep practising what helps you.

bands.label: Strong well-being
bands.recommendation: Your answers suggest frequent experiences that support social well-being. Continue the habits and connections that help you.

questions.question: How often do you feel that you have someone to talk to when you need support?
How often do you feel that your relationships are meaningful and fulfilling?
How often do you feel connected to your community or social groups?
How often do you feel that you are able to communicate your feelings effectively to others?
How often do you feel that you are accepted and valued by those around you?
